name: mp-rematch
title: The real lobby starts a match, reconvenes after End Match and starts a second round

checklist.what: Round 1 runs on host, with actors responding to the input script.
checklist.assert: probe observes Running gameplay for three seconds in this round

checklist.what: Round 2 runs on host, with actors responding to the input script.
checklist.assert: probe observes Running gameplay for three seconds in this round

checklist.what: The completed match returns to the live rematch lobby.
